quantity_semantics: dimensionless mutation-effect score = log P(mutant) - log P(wild-type) under a structure-conditioned inverse-folding model
training_task: cDNA117k stability fine-tune (per official variant naming)
training_dataset: cDNA117k (Stability-Oracle) for this variant; note: SKEMPI-binding fine-tuned variants are SEPARATE (hermes_*_ft_skempi_ddg_bi)
skempi_binding_label_exposure: NOT for the cDNA117k variant used here; the model name must NOT be read as SKEMPI-supervised binding regression
prediction_semantics: score only; NOT calibrated kcal/mol ddG
single_vs_multi_mutation: single-point only in the primary matched set (multi-point rows do not map)
sign_convention: hermes_proxy = -(log_proba_mt - log_proba_wt); aligned so that V8 ddG>0 = weaker binding; direction verified empirically (r=+0.1688 > 0)
